commits.message:
feat(hermes-850): add Gmail and Microsoft Graph email provider connectors

Jobfynder receives hotlist/requirement emails on both Gmail and Office 365
mailboxes, not just via a generic inbound-parse webhook. Adds two new
providers following the existing contract-provider pattern (same shape as
whatsapp/slack/teams - code ready, configured:false until real credentials
are supplied):

- app/providers/gmail/service.py: normalize_gmail_message() converts a
  Gmail API users.messages.get resource into the same normalized shape
  app/providers/email/service.py already produces, so it flows through the
  existing, already-verified email intake pipeline (mailbox routing ->
  deterministic hotlist/requirement parsing) unchanged. Also decodes Gmail
  Cloud Pub/Sub push envelopes (historyId only - actual message fetch
  requires HERMES_GMAIL_* credentials, not yet configured).
- app/providers/microsoft_graph/service.py: same pattern for Microsoft
  Graph message resources, including HTML body stripping.
- app/routers/gmail_provider.py: /providers/gmail/status,
  /providers/gmail/push (Pub/Sub push endpoint, always acks).
- app/routers/microsoft_graph_provider.py: /providers/microsoft-graph/status,
  /providers/microsoft-graph/webhook - implements the Graph subscription
  validationToken handshake, required before Graph will ever create a
  subscription against this endpoint.
- app/providers/registry.py: gmail_health()/microsoft_graph_health(),
  registered in PROVIDER_NAMES and GET /providers/status.
- .env.example: HERMES_GMAIL_* and HERMES_MS_GRAPH_* placeholders.
- scripts/hermes-850-gmail-graph-provider-check.py: verifies both
  normalizers against realistic sample payloads (base64url Gmail body
  decoding, HTML-body Graph messages, mailbox routing, and that normalized
  output parses correctly through the existing email_parsing pipeline).

Verified: new checks pass (7/7), existing HERMES-850 checks still pass
(10/10 unit, full email-to-draft integration), app imports cleanly with
103 OpenAPI paths (99 previous + 4 new), /providers/status correctly lists
both as contract/unconfigured.

Not done: no live credentials configured (deliberate - provider choice and
OAuth app registration is pending), so no real email flows through this
yet. The fetch-and-normalize step for a live push notification (calling the
Gmail/Graph API to retrieve the actual message) is not implemented -
normalize_gmail_message()/normalize_graph_message() are ready for it, the
authenticated fetch call itself is the remaining piece once credentials
exist.
